warning.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The selected model was not found.
warning.IMAGE_OVERRIDE_INCOMPATIBLE: The selected image {{image}} is incompatible with the node vendor, framework, operating system, or host architecture. Choose a different image or node.
warning.IMAGE_ENGINE_DEFAULT_INCOMPATIBLE: The default engine image {{image}} supports NVIDIA CUDA nodes only and is incompatible with the selected node. Choose a different image or node.
warning.IMAGE_OVERRIDE_UNVERIFIED: The selected image {{image}} is not in the Image Catalog, so its compatibility with this node cannot be verified automatically.
warning.COMPUTE_NETWORK_FALLBACK: Some of the selected nodes are on a compute network, but not all of them are on the same one, so this deployment runs over the management network. To avoid it, put every node on one compute network, or turn off compute traffic on the management network for those nodes.
warning.IMAGE_DIGEST_UNVERIFIED: The selected image {{image}} is pinned to a digest. The node's actual local digest will be used; verify it on the confirmation page.
warning.IMAGE_CATALOG_NO_MATCH: No enabled Image Catalog entry matches this node. The engine default image will be used.
warning.IMAGE_CATALOG_NO_MATCH_DOMESTIC: No compatible Image Catalog entry matches this node for the domestic accelerator, so automatic fallback to latest is blocked. Import a matching image or specify a verified private image manually and retry.
warning.IMAGE_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: The Image Catalog could not be read. The engine default image will be used.
warning.IMAGE_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE_DOMESTIC: The Image Catalog could not be read, so automatic image resolution for the domestic accelerator is blocked.
warning.IMAGE_DRIVER_COMPATIBILITY: The {{framework}} {{framework_version}} image has a {{level}} driver compatibility advisory: {{reason}}. Deployment may continue.
warning.PLANNING_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: Configuration for inference engine {{engine}} is unavailable: {{detail}}. Select another engine.
warning.PLANNING_GPU_ARCH_CAUTION: GPU architecture note: {{detail}}. Verify the selected precision and image version.
warning.PLANNING_MODEL_WEIGHT_UNKNOWN: The model weight size is unknown, so the current VRAM estimate is incomplete. Refresh the model metadata and try again.
warning.PLANNING_KV_BELOW_CONTEXT: The estimated KV cache capacity is {{kv_tokens}} tokens, below the maximum context of {{max_model_len}}. Actual capacity depends on the attention architecture and inference engine, so the estimate may be inaccurate. You can lower the maximum context or continue with the current settings; the engine may fail to start.
warning.IMAGE_PARTITION_PROFILE_UNBUILT: Image CANN {{framework_version}} × {{arch}} is not in the built dGPU asset matrix; the probe only verifies the node execution path, the image itself may still be incompatible.
warning.IMAGE_PARTITION_PROFILE_UNVERIFIED: The dGPU assets for image CANN {{framework_version}} × {{arch}} have not been verified on real hardware yet.
warning.PD_UNVERIFIED_COMBINATION: PD combined with {{feature}} is allowed but has not been verified on real hardware yet.
warning.PD_GPU_MODELS_DIFFER: The PD roles run on different GPU models ({{models}}); throughput and latency will differ by role.
warning.PD_SAME_NODE_THROUGHPUT: Every PD instance is on the same node, which trades some throughput for lower decode latency compared with spreading them across nodes.
warning.PD_KV_OFFLOAD_PREFILL_ONLY: KV offload only runs on the prefill instances; decode instances never carry a KV cache tier in a PD deployment.
warning.ASCEND_V1_COMPAT_MULTI_NODE: The vLLM-Ascend rc2 A3 V1 compatibility rendezvous on {{runtime}} only works within one node, so it cannot coordinate a {{nnodes}}-node deployment ({{image}}). The deployment can still be created; if it hangs at startup, set VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1, use Docker or nerdctl, or deploy on one node.
warning.ASCEND_V1_COMPAT_DATA_PARALLEL: Data parallel size {{dp}} with the vLLM-Ascend rc2 A3 V1 compatibility script on {{runtime}} has not been verified on real hardware ({{image}}). The deployment can still be created; if it hangs at startup, use Docker or nerdctl, or set VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1.
warning.ASCEND_COMPAT_MANUAL_SHELL: The vLLM-Ascend compatibility script for {{image}} on {{runtime}} patches the model runner it expects, and a manual shell command cannot be checked against it. The deployment can still be created; make sure the command starts the runner you intend (VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER).
warning.ENGRAM_SHARED_MEMORY_RUNTIME: Engram cpu_offload with dp_shared_memory ({{flag}}) needs about {{shm_gib}} GiB of shared memory and unlimited locked memory. {{runtime}} uses the host's /dev/shm and limits directly, which the platform cannot see. The deployment can still be created; check the host, or use Docker or nerdctl.
warning.ENGRAM_CONFIG_UNCERTAIN: The Engram configuration ({{flag}}) cannot be read, so the platform cannot tell whether it shares memory. If it does, it needs about {{shm_gib}} GiB of shared memory and unlimited locked memory, and {{runtime}} uses the host's /dev/shm and limits directly. The deployment can still be created; check the configuration and the host.
warning.ENGRAM_MANUAL_UNCHECKED: The manual command mentions Engram ({{flag}}) but is too dynamic to read, so the platform did not derive shared-memory and locked-memory settings from it. Make sure the shared memory and memlock are sufficient, or use engine mode.
warning.ASCEND_SLEEP_EXPANDABLE_SEGMENTS_DISABLE: Sleep mode on Ascend cannot run with expandable segments, so the platform changed the template's {{variable}} from {{template_value}} to {{value}}. NPU memory may fragment more: the KV cache can be smaller, and a configuration with little memory headroom may run out of memory at startup or under load. If it does, lower gpu_memory_utilization or max_model_len, or turn sleep off.

schedule.runtime_unavailable: The node has no available container runtime. Install and start Docker; for NVIDIA GPUs, also configure NVIDIA Container Toolkit for Docker; the built-in runveil needs a Linux node on x86_64 or arm64.
schedule.serving_unavailable: The node has no network that may carry serving traffic: it is on no serving network, and its management network may not carry serving. Allow serving on the node's management network, attach a serving network, or select another node.
schedule.dtype_unsupported: The current GPU architecture does not support the selected precision or quantization method. Adjust the precision or quantization method, or choose another GPU.
schedule.dtype_unsupported_detail: {{detail}}. Adjust the precision or quantization method, or choose another GPU.
schedule.partition_unavailable: The selected node has no ready dGPU backend. Disable dGPU or select a node whose dGPU capability is ready.
schedule.insufficient_disk: The node does not have enough disk space for the model weights. Free some disk space or select another node.
schedule.insufficient_runtime_disk: The runtime filesystem does not have enough space to unpack the selected image. Free runtime storage or select another node.
schedule.sleep_unsupported_on_node: {{vendor}} nodes cannot put an engine to sleep. Turn off sleep for this deployment or select another node.
schedule.multi_node_unsupported_on_node: {{vendor}} nodes cannot run ranks across several nodes. Deploy on a single node or select other nodes.
schedule.pd_unsupported_on_node: PD disaggregation is not supported on {{vendor}} nodes. Select other nodes.
schedule.kv_disk_unsupported_on_node: {{vendor}} nodes have no KV disk tier. Turn off the KV disk tier or select another node.
schedule.storage_unavailable: The storages that can serve this model are not ready on this node. Check the storages' node status or select another node.
schedule.model_exceeds_cache_limit: The model is larger than this node's cache limit for the storage. Raise the cache limit or use a storage that reads in place.
schedule.cache_full_in_use: This node's cache for the storage is full of models that are in use, so no room can be made. Raise the cache limit or stop the deployments that use those models.
schedule.model_missing_in_storage: The storage does not hold this model. Scan it again or choose another source.
schedule.storage_disabled: The node lacks the model and its storage is read-only, so nothing can be put there. Enable the storage or choose another one.
schedule.no_healthy_gpu: None of the node's own accelerators is at a health level that can serve. Resolve the GPU warnings or faults, or select another node.
schedule.no_owned_gpu: The node has no accelerator of its own to use: they may all be passed through to virtual machines, have no driver bound, or be held by another driver. Check the node's accelerator list or select another node.
schedule.gpus_held_outside_platform: Every usable accelerator on the node is occupied by processes outside the platform. Free those processes on the node or select another node.
schedule.no_free_gpu: The selected node has no free GPUs. Stop or sleep another deployment, or select another node.
schedule.placement_rejected: The selected GPU set does not satisfy this template's placement rules. Adjust the GPU count or choose compatible GPUs.
schedule.engine_ports_exhausted: Every engine port {{start}}–{{end}} on node {{node}} is in use by instances or other host services. Free a port in that range or select another node.
schedule.pool_empty: No node can take a replica now: of {{nodes}} nodes, {{unmet}} do not satisfy the deployment's node requirements, {{cordoned}} are cordoned and {{offline}} are offline. Bring a node online or uncordon it, add one that satisfies the requirements, or widen them.
schedule.node_cordoned: Node {{node}} is cordoned; the replica starts once scheduling resumes there, or pick another node under Adjust replicas.
schedule.pool_no_fit: None of the {{tried}} best of {{candidates}} candidate nodes has room for a replica. The best, {{node}}, refused: {{first}}. Free resources there, scale down another deployment, or add nodes.
schedule.waiting_for_yield: Waiting until {{holders}}; the replica then goes on {{node}}.
schedule.reserved_for_sleepers: GPU {{gpus}} on {{node}} is kept for {{sleepers}}, asleep there until a request wakes it; a deployment that never yields is not placed on those cards. Choose another card, enable sleep for this deployment and pick a yield policy that shares cards, or put the deployment on the card to sleep by hand (a sleep ordered by hand keeps no card).
schedule.does_not_wait_for_yield: GPU {{gpus}} on {{node}} is held by {{occupants}}; this deployment never yields, so it does not wait for them to give the cards up. Enable sleep for this deployment and pick a yield policy that shares cards, and it waits for {{yielders}} to give them up by yield policy.
schedule.held_by_non_yielding: GPU {{gpus}} on {{node}} is held by {{occupants}}; {{blockers}} never yields and does not give its cards to this deployment. Choose another card, or enable sleep for {{blockers}} and pick a yield policy that shares cards.
schedule.model_unavailable: Model {{model}} could not be acquired on node {{node}}, or waits for a source to be chosen, so no replica starts there. Retry the sync for that node on the models page, or use the public download instead.
schedule.image_delivery_waiting: Waiting for image {{image}} to arrive on node {{node}}. Check its transfer progress on the images page; a stalled peer transfer is cancelled so it can be retried.
schedule.image_delivery_failed: Pre-pulling image {{image}} on node {{node}} failed, so the multi-node deployment cannot start. The platform keeps retrying; check the reason on the images page or review the pull settings.
schedule.image_source_forbidden: The pull source rules that apply to node {{node}} forbid every source of image {{image}} (no endpoint and pulling from its own registry is off), so the replica cannot start. Adjust them under Settings → Pull settings → Source rules.
schedule.weights_fetch_forbidden: The pull source rules that apply to node {{node}} forbid every address model {{model}} could be downloaded from (no endpoint and downloading from its own site is off), and no peer or storage can provide it, so the replica cannot start. Adjust them under Settings → Pull settings → Source rules, or register the model's path on a node that has it, or put it on a shared storage.
schedule.filters_passed: The node passed the runtime, precision compatibility, and disk checks.
schedule.no_fit: Startup fixed requirement does not fit: this node needs {{gpus}} GPU(s) (TP {{tp}} × PP {{pp}}), {{gpu_count}} candidate GPU(s), {{required_gib}} GiB required per GPU versus {{available_gib}} GiB available at the selected utilization.
schedule.sleep_residue_blocks_startup: The engine cannot start while sleeping residue remains: startup reservation is {{startup_gib}} GiB, but only {{available_gib}} GiB is free after keeping {{sleeping_gib}} GiB resident.
schedule.tp_head_count_not_divisible: Tensor parallelism tp={{tp}} cannot divide {{head_count}} attention heads. Choose a divisible parallelism value.
schedule.insufficient_shared_gpus: This node needs {{gpus}} GPU(s) (TP {{tp}} × PP {{pp}}) with {{required_gib}} GiB each, but only {{available}} GPUs are available. Reduce the VRAM requirement or release GPUs.
schedule.insufficient_empty_gpus: This node needs {{gpus}} free GPU(s) (TP {{tp}} × PP {{pp}}), but only {{available}} meet the requirements ({{required_gib}} GiB per GPU). Release GPUs or adjust the parallelism.
schedule.pinned_gpus_unavailable: GPU {{gpus}} on {{node}}, which this unit is pinned to, is held by {{holders}}. The unit waits for it; switch the deployment to automatic placement to let the platform use free GPUs instead.
schedule.topology_nvlink: These {{gpus}} GPUs are all high-speed interconnected.
schedule.topology_numa: These {{gpus}} GPUs are within the same NUMA node.
schedule.topology_cross: These {{gpus}} GPUs span NUMA nodes with PCIe-only interconnects, which may reduce performance.
schedule.topology_single: The deployment uses a single GPU.
schedule.packing: The packing strategy prefers fewer GPUs.
schedule.tight_fit: GPU capacity closely matches the VRAM requirement.
schedule.placement_preference: The template prefers this GPU count: {{count}} GPUs.
schedule.degraded_gpus_used: {{count}} of the chosen GPUs are at warning level; they are used only because the healthy GPUs cannot take this deployment.
schedule.invalid_request: The launch configuration reaching the scheduler is invalid: VRAM utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} is outside the allowed range. Reload the page and evaluate again.
schedule.runtime_unsupported: {{vendor}} requires {{required_os}}/{{required_arch}} with {{required_runtime}}; this node reports {{os}}/{{arch}} and {{runtime}}.
schedule.runtime_unreported: {{vendor}} requires {{required_os}}/{{required_arch}} with {{required_runtime}}; this node has not reported all required runtime facts.
schedule.accelerator_feature_unsupported: {{vendor}} does not support {{feature}}. Change the launch options or select another accelerator.
schedule.accelerator_device_selection_required: {{vendor}} requires an explicit GPU assignment before launch.
schedule.launch_features_unknown: The launch command could not be inspected for {{vendor}}. Use a recognized engine entrypoint or structured launch parameters.

launchConfig.extraArgsHelp: Arguments outside the parameter dictionary. A dictionary flag typed here moves into its own field.
launchConfig.templateArgsHint: Carried by the inference template and sent with the deployment. An argument you add above with the same flag takes precedence.
launchConfig.manualEstimateDetail: The command text is the launch configuration, so parameter fields are read-only and the VRAM estimate does not apply. Node, GPU, tensor parallelism, and dGPU memory still come from this form.

containerOverrides.shmHelp: Size limit of the container's /dev/shm tmpfs, not a memory reservation. Tensor-parallel workers and NCCL communicate through it.
containerOverrides.shmHelpDefault: Size limit of the container's /dev/shm tmpfs, not a memory reservation. Tensor-parallel workers and NCCL communicate through it. Leave empty for the engine default of {{size}} GiB, plus the CPU memory tier's size when one is enabled (the engine keeps that tier in /dev/shm). Under --ipc=host the host's /dev/shm applies instead.
containerOverrides.shmHelpResolved: Size limit of the container's /dev/shm tmpfs, not a memory reservation. Tensor-parallel workers and NCCL communicate through it. Leave empty for {{size}} GiB: the engine default, plus the CPU memory tier's size when one is enabled (the engine keeps that tier in /dev/shm). A size you set must be at least the tier's. Under --ipc=host the host's /dev/shm applies instead.
containerOverrides.startTimeoutHelp: Maximum wait for engine health after startup. Leave empty for an automatic budget using the cluster default as a floor and the known engine deadline. An explicit value takes priority.
containerOverrides.startTimeoutHelpDefault: Maximum wait for engine health after startup. Leave empty for an automatic budget using the cluster default of {{seconds}} s as a floor and the known engine deadline. An explicit value takes priority.

wake.help: Wakes the deployment and replaces all its instances with the new configuration.

observer.control_plane: Evidence: control-plane records; not a live filesystem check.

reason.source_ready: The control-plane records show a ready model copy.
reason.cache_fill_required: The shared storage holds the model; this node must fill its cache before starting.
reason.shared_transfer_pending: A transfer to the shared storage is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
reason.copy_in_progress: A model copy has been accepted and is still in progress. It is not ready yet.
reason.not_on_node: This node has no complete model-copy record. Check other copies or prepare the model first.
reason.model_missing_in_storage: This storage has no complete model-copy record. Check the model’s copies or transfer status; this does not prove that its directory is absent.
reason.storage_unavailable: The storage is not ready on this node. Check its mount status on the storage page.
reason.storage_not_on_node: The storage does not apply to this node. Check its node selection or choose another target.
reason.storage_not_found: The selected storage no longer exists. Choose an available storage.
reason.storage_disabled: The storage cannot accept the required model acquisition. Enable it or choose another target.
reason.facts_unavailable: Model or storage state could not be read. The availability of model copies is unknown.
reason.storage_access_required: The model path was not checked because storage access is a prerequisite.
reason.peer_available: An eligible peer has a model-copy record. The actual transfer connection has not been checked.
reason.no_acquisition_path: No executable model acquisition path was found under this request’s constraints. Check copies, the save target and sync groups.
reason.source_timeout: Reading model-source metadata from the management node timed out. Check source connectivity and retry.
reason.source_cancelled: The model-source metadata check was cancelled.
reason.source_unavailable: The management node could not read model-source metadata. This does not indicate that a download from the GPU node was tested.
reason.metadata_not_checked: Model-source metadata was not checked in this request.
reason.source_not_required: The current path does not require access to the public model source.
reason.not_mounted: The storage is not mounted on this node. Check the storage’s node status and mount configuration.
reason.permission_denied: The reported storage access was denied. Check the mount and file access permissions.
reason.model_record_ready: The control-plane records show a complete model copy.
reason.model_transfer_pending: The model transfer is still in progress. Wait for it to finish before reading the model.
reason.storage_state_unknown: This node has not reported a usable storage state. Whether the storage is mounted is unknown.
reason.storage_ready: The node’s reported storage state is ready.
reason.metadata_only: Only source metadata was requested. This does not verify all weight files or a download from the GPU node.
reason.source_dns_failed: The management node could not resolve the model-source hostname. Check its DNS configuration.
reason.source_tls_failed: TLS certificate verification failed while the management node read model-source metadata. Check the certificate and trust configuration.
reason.source_connect_failed: The management node could not connect to the model source. Check its connection route and the source service.
reason.source_authentication: The model source rejected the configured credentials. Check its credentials and access permissions.
reason.storage_mounting: The node is mounting the storage. Wait until it is ready, then recheck the model path.
reason.storage_unresponsive: The storage is not responding on this node. Check the node’s storage diagnostics.
reason.storage_unsupported: The node does not support the required storage mount. Check the node platform and selected storage type.
reason.storage_not_writable: The selected storage cannot accept model writes. Check its writer node and write permissions.
reason.unsupported_storage: The model source uses an unsupported storage type. Check the storage configuration.
reason.shared_path_invalid: The shared model record has an invalid relative path. Scan the storage again or register a valid model path.
reason.no_storage_path: The candidate copy source {{source}} and target {{target}} have no common network allowed to carry storage sync. Check the storage sync role on the management network or another common network on both nodes.
reason.peer_transport_required: The peer acquisition path was not accepted because a permitted storage-sync network is required. Resolve the preceding peer network check first.
